tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background below the header. Carries ink, muted, accent-text, note, warn, danger.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Post cards, callouts and the demo frame on surface. Carries the same text tokens as surface.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Header and title-bar ground; the sky above the sea. Ink and muted read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and the site title on surface, surface-raised and sky (13:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Dates, bylines, captions, the % prompt and the header tagline on surface, surface-raised and sky (5.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between post cards and above the footer. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders of controls, tags and the demo frame (3.2:1 or better on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Shell coral: the cursor, the edited word (c / sea), primary button fill and decorative marks. Not a text colour on light grounds.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, the active nav item and coral text on surface, surface-raised and sky (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill, such as the primary button label (5.7:1 day, 7.2:1 night).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset; 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The sun (moon at night) and text highlight: mark and ::selection backgrounds, with ink on top.

tokens.name: terminal
tokens.usage: Code blocks and terminal panels; dark in both themes.

tokens.name: terminal-ink
tokens.usage: Code on terminal (13:1 or better).

tokens.name: terminal-muted
tokens.usage: Comments, line numbers and the panel label on terminal (6.1:1 or better).

tokens.name: foam
tokens.usage: Wave crests, spray and backwash in the header scene.

tokens.name: glint
tokens.usage: Sun glints blinking on the front water.

tokens.name: back
tokens.usage: Far wave layer body.

tokens.name: back-light
tokens.usage: Far wave layer surface highlight row.

tokens.name: mid
tokens.usage: Middle wave layer body.

tokens.name: mid-light
tokens.usage: Middle wave layer surface highlight row.

tokens.name: front
tokens.usage: Front wave layer body and the shore surge.

tokens.name: front-light
tokens.usage: Front wave layer surface highlight row.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Deep water band at the bottom of the scene and the title-bar strip.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: North Pier stonework.

tokens.name: stone-top
tokens.usage: Pier coping, the top two art pixels of the wall.

tokens.name: mortar
tokens.usage: Mortar lines between the pier's stones.

tokens.name: stone-wet
tokens.usage: The pier's seaward edge.

tokens.name: tower-light
tokens.usage: Lighthouse white bands.

tokens.name: tower-dark
tokens.usage: Lighthouse black bands, lantern frame and gallery.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: Lighthouse lamp when lit and its halo.

tokens.name: lamp-off
tokens.usage: Lighthouse lamp between flashes.

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: Note callout label and icon on surface-raised (7.2:1 or better). Always paired with the word Note.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning callout label on surface-raised (6.9:1 or better). Always paired with the word Warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger callout label on surface-raised (6.5:1 or better). Always paired with the word Danger.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Clouds in the header sky.

tokens.name: cloud-shade
tokens.usage: Underside of the header clouds.

styles.name: site-title
styles.usage: The site name in the SiteHeader only; scales down to 18px on phones. Pixels live in the masthead and nowhere else.

styles.name: title-bar
styles.usage: The site name in the compact post header.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Waves that break on a wall
styles.usage: Post title, once per page. Bricolage Grotesque ExtraBold, tight tracking.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: The sea was the hard part.
styles.usage: A post's opening paragraph and the home page intro.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each layer is a sprite sheet stepped through with CSS.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figure 2. The break, frame by frame.
styles.usage: Figure and demo captions, in muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels: card dates, the DEMO marker, callout kinds, code and demo bars. Replaces the old pixel label.

spacing.note: A 4px base: one art pixel in the header scene at desktop size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: One art pixel; icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between post cards; callout padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side gutter from 640px up; space above h2.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between header and content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space above the footer.

radius.note: Pixel world: corners are square. Rounding is reserved for tiny details.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, code blocks, callouts, the demo frame: everything by default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code and focus ring corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Photos and screenshots inside posts.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows, no blur, like a sprite's drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-step
tokens.usage: Post card on hover and the primary button.

tokens.name: shadow-step-sm
tokens.usage: Pressed buttons and tags on hover.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the post column including figures.

tokens.name: art-pixel
tokens.usage: Art pixel in the header scene at desktop size; 3px below 640px and 2px below 360px.
